assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game UI texture for RainShadow. A SINGLE long rectangular EMPTY action-bar frame made of tarnished antique brass, charcoal leather and dark walnut. Original understated medieval detective RPG interface. Front-facing orthographic perfectly horizontal. Fine double-line brass rim, small engraved corners, very subtle scuffed leather interior. No protruding emblems, no portraits, no buttons, no icons, no text, no dividers, no words. The central 85% of the panel is empty nearly black matte leather, low contrast, intended for code-rendered action buttons. Symmetric rectangular silhouette, only slightly rounded corners. Wide 5:1 shape, centered on landscape canvas with transparent space above and below; artwork fully contained with no clipping. Transparent background with clean alpha, no floating noise or detached decoration. Match warm gold frame and charcoal inset of RainShadow Combat Begins banner; avoid red velvet, bright gold, excessive filigree, neon, glows or shadows. This is a reusable nine-slice panel texture: corners occupy no more than 8% of width, straight uninterrupted edges and quiet center.

assets.initialPrompt:
Production game UI atlas: TWENTY simple flat WHITE SILHOUETTE SYMBOLS on uniform pure BLACK background. Exact FIVE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, equal square cells, canvas 5:4. Each symbol centered in the central 65% of its cell, wide black gutters, never touching adjacent cells. White cut-paper silhouettes with essential black cutouts, crisp bold forms readable at 40px. No gradients, texture, outlines, colors, glow, borders, lettering or grid lines. Fantasy RPG abilities. The WEAPON ATTACKS must be WEAPONS ONLY, never warriors or archers. Exact left-to-right top-to-bottom order:
Row1: single diagonal shortsword (Melee); single diagonal arrow with fletching and sharp point (Ranged); shield with protective rays (Ward); standing bear side profile (Bear Form); heavy sword with three strong impact rays around blade tip (Power Strike).
Row2: elegant curved blade with curved sweeping motion line (Feint); arrow passing through circular bullseye target (Aimed Shot); arrow piercing a metal shackle anchored to a short ground line (Pinning Shot); crouching hooded silhouette (Hide); single downward pointed dagger with small crescent shadow behind it (Sneak Attack).
Row3: jug pouring water over flame (Extinguish); open palm with two forward motion chevrons (Shove); horizontal sword above low sweeping arc and downward arrow (Trip Attack); bear paw with three claws (Claw); roaring bear head (Roar).
Row4: running cloaked silhouette (Flee); upright human surrounded by circular return arrow (Human Form); bundle of three arrows (Normal Ammo); one flaming arrow (Fire Ammo); hourglass (End Turn).
One isolated icon per cell. All weapon attacks are object symbols, NO human or archer figures except the explicitly requested Hide, Flee, Human Form icons. Consistent optical weight and generous cell padding. Original RainShadow game artwork.
assets.finalEditPrompt: Make a precise edit to this 5-column 4-row white-on-black game UI icon atlas. Preserve the canvas, grid alignment, black background, white silhouette style, all cell centers, and SEVENTEEN other icons unchanged. Change ONLY THREE cells: row2 column4 replace crouching full-body human with a simple empty hood containing one small eye slit (Hide); row4 column1 replace running full-body human with two boot footprints and two small forward chevrons (Flee); row4 column2 replace full-body human with a simple human face profile enclosed by the existing circular return arrow (Return to Human Form). Every symbol should be object-based, no full human figures anywhere. Keep pure white silhouettes and black cutouts, no shading, textures, labels or colors. Preserve wide black gutters between the twenty cells. Keep all sword and arrow icons unchanged.
